# relations

A table. Typed edges between identities, such as works_at (person → company)

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `from_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id) |
| `relation` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `to_id` | TEXT | NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id) |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL |

Table constraints: `PRIMARY KEY (from_id, relation, to_id)`.

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE relations (
  from_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  relation   TEXT NOT NULL,               -- e.g. 'works_at'
  to_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES identities(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (from_id, relation, to_id)
);
```
